name: Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition Directive

articleSource.note: The act as published in the Official Journal, not a consolidation. Headings verbatim; a requirement with no curated text is cut from the article's own operative words, not paraphrased.

articles.title: Reporting by the Commission and review
articles.requirement: By 27 September 2031, the Commission shall submit a report on the application of this Directive to the European Parliament and to the Council.

articles.title: Transposition
articles.requirement: By 27 March 2026, Member States shall adopt and publish the measures necessary to comply with this Directive. They shall immediately inform the Commission thereof.

articles.title: Entry into force
articles.requirement: This Directive shall enter into force on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
